Research programme

Exact geometry as a generator of physics

Exact algebraic and geometric structures in field theory, quantum geometry, and information geometry.

My research uses rigid algebraic and geometric structures to make physical questions exactly computable. The recurring pattern is simple: choose an exact structure, compute its geometry, and extract physics — fields, charges, phases, distances, particle-sector structures, or transport laws.

Directions Featured works Publications Talks

Common mechanism

Exact input, explicit computation, physical output

Exact input

Symmetry, spectral triples, quantum spaces, division algebras, gauge ansätze

Explicit computation

Connections, curvature, phases, charges, spectral distances, transport

Physical output

Fields, particle sectors, black-hole phases, information metrics

The point is not to force every problem into one formalism, but to demand that the geometry be explicit, the computation controlled, and the physical interpretation earned.
